affecteddate.title: Affected Date
affecteddate.remarks: Date when user was affected by incident. Enter a date or click the Select Date button and select a date.

globalticketid.title: Related to Global ID
globalticketid.remarks: Identifies the global ticket to which this incident is related. Enter a value or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value.

internalpriority.title: Internal Priority
internalpriority.remarks: Priority of the incident as determined by the service desk agent.

externalrecid.title: External Record
externalrecid.remarks: Ticket ID for any Ticket external to MAXIMO

ownergroup.title: Owner Group
ownergroup.remarks: Owner Group of the incident record. This group has overall responsibility for the incident. Use the Select Action menu to assign an owner group. You can enter a value either in this field or the Owner field.

source.title: Source
source.remarks: Source of Ticket Generation like email

origrecordid.title: Originating Record
origrecordid.remarks: Identifies the ticket or work order that created this incident record. Enter a value or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value.

sitevisit.title: Site Visit Required
sitevisit.remarks: Falg used to indicate of a Ticket requires an on-site visit for investigation

calcshift.title: Shift
calcshift.remarks: Along with the calculation calendar, sets the business hours that calculate the Target Contact, Target Response, and Target Resolution dates on a ticket or work order. Click the Select Value button to choose a shift.

solution.title: Solution
solution.remarks: Identifies the solution. Enter a value or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value. Maximo copies information to the Symptom, Cause, and/or Resolution fields, but you can edit it.

actualstart.title: Actual Start
actualstart.remarks: Actual start date. Enter a date or click the Select Date button and select a date.

siteid.title: Site
siteid.remarks: Unique identifier of the site. Enter a value or click the Select Value button.

isknownerror.title: Is Known Error
isknownerror.remarks: Specifies whether this is a known error. If the check box is selected, this is a known error. If the check box is cleared, this is not a known error.

actualcontactdate.title: Actual Contact
actualcontactdate.remarks: Actual contact date. Enter a date or click the Select Date button and select a date.

affectedphone.title: Phone
affectedphone.remarks: Telephone number of person affected by the incident.

reportedpriority.title: Reported Priority
reportedpriority.remarks: Priority of incident as determined by person reporting the incident.

impact.title: Impact
impact.remarks: The Business Impact/severity of the Ticket

targetstart.title: Target Start
targetstart.remarks: Target start date. Enter a date or click the Select Date button.

problemcode_longdescription.title: Symptom
problemcode_longdescription.remarks: Long description of the symptom. If you entered a value in the Solution field, Maximo may enter data here, but you can edit it.

targetdesc.title: Target Description
targetdesc.remarks: Temporary target description for targeting CIs

createwomulti.title: Create WO Options
createwomulti.remarks: Identifies what happens to Multi table entries on Tickets when follow-up Work Orders are created

reportedemail.title: E-mail
reportedemail.remarks: E-mail address of person reporting the incident.

calccalendar.title: Calendar
calccalendar.remarks: Business days and times used to calculate the Target Contact, Target Response, and Target Resolution dates on a ticket or work order. Click the Detail Menu to select a calendar or go to the Calendars application to create one.

status.title: Status
status.remarks: Status of the incident record. If you are not viewing the Change Status dialog box, click the Change Status button in the toolbar to change the status. Default statuses are NEW, QUEUED, PENDING, INPROG, RESOLVED, and CLOSED. See the Incidents Help for more information on statuses.

commodity.title: Service
commodity.remarks: Service provided or purchased. Enter a value or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value.

selfservsolaccess.title: Self-Service Access
selfservsolaccess.remarks: Specifies whether the solution applied to this ticket is visible to the self-service user who opened the associated self-service Service Request. If the check box is selected, the self-service user can view this record. If the check box is cleared the solution record is not visible to the self-service user.

commoditygroup.title: Service Group
commoditygroup.remarks: Identifies the group providing the service. Enter a value or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value.

inheritstatus.title: Inherit Status Changes
inheritstatus.remarks: Inherit status from follow up record

reportdate.title: Reported Date
reportdate.remarks: Date when the incident was reported. Enter a date or click the Select Date button.

origrecsiteid.title: Originating Record Site
origrecsiteid.remarks: Site Identifier of the originating Record

description.title: Summary
description.remarks: Describes the incident. To enter or view additional information, click the Long Description button. Additonal text that you enter appears in the Details field.

targetcontactdate.title: Target Contact
targetcontactdate.remarks: Target contact date. Enter a date or click the Select Date button.

reportedby.title: Reported By
reportedby.remarks: Person reporting the issue for the Ticket

assignedownergroup.title: Assigned Owner Group
assignedownergroup.remarks: Assigned Owner Group of the ticket record. This group has overall responsibility for the solution. Use the Select Action menu to assign an owner group. You can enter a value either in this field or the Owner field.

origrecorgid.title: Originating Record Oganization
origrecorgid.remarks: Organization Identifier of the originating Record

urgency.title: Urgency
urgency.remarks: A reflection of the speed in which a Ticket should be resolved

vendor.title: Vendor
vendor.remarks: Identifies the vendor for the service, service group, or asset. Enter a value or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value.

assetnum.title: Asset
assetnum.remarks: Identifies the primary asset on the incident record. If the incident record is for an asset, enter its identifier in the Asset field or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value. The Select Value dialog box, by default, displays all assets where the person ID in the Affected Person field is associated with an asset as either an asset user or an asset custodian. If the Asset Site field contains a value before you use the Select Value dialog box, the list of assets is always filtered by that value. After you select an asset, Maximo copies the asset location to the Location field. You can enter related assets and/or locations in the Related Assets table window.

reportedphone.title: Phone
reportedphone.remarks: Telephone number of person reporting the incident.

assetsiteid.title: Asset Site
assetsiteid.remarks: Site of the asset on the incident record. The default value is the site of the person record in the Affected User field. Enter a value or click the Select Value button. If the Asset Site field contains a value before you access the Select Value dialog box on the Asset or Location field, the list of assets or locations is always filtered by this value. You cannot edit this field after you have associated assets or locations with a record; you must remove the associations before you can edit this field.

ticketid.title: Incident
ticketid.remarks: Identifies the incident record. This value must be unique for all incident records.

owner.title: Owner
owner.remarks: Owner of the incident record. This person has overall responsibility for the incident. Use the Select Action menu to assign an owner. You can enter a value either in this field or the Owner Group field.

calcorgid.title: Organization
calcorgid.remarks: Organization associated with the calculation calendar, and used with the Calendar and Shift fields to calculate the Target Contact, Target Response, and Target Resolution dates on a ticket or work order. Click the Detail Menu button to select an organization or go to the Organizations application to create one.

description_longdescription.title: Details
description_longdescription.remarks: Long description of the incident. To check spelling of text you enter, click the Long Description button next to the Summary field.

affectedemail.title: E-mail
affectedemail.remarks: E-mail address of person affected by the incident.

actualfinish.title: Actual Finish
actualfinish.remarks: Actual finish date. Enter a date or click the Select Date button and select a date.

fr2code_longdescription.title: Resolution
fr2code_longdescription.remarks: Long description of the resolution. If you entered a value in the Solution field, Maximo may enter data here, but you can edit it.

relatedtoglobal.title: Related to Global Issue
relatedtoglobal.remarks: Flag used to determine if a Ticket is related to a global issue Ticket

hasactivity.title: Has Activity
hasactivity.remarks: Does this ticket has any activity

targetfinish.title: Target Finish
targetfinish.remarks: Target finish date. Enter a date or click the Select Date button.

failurecode.title: Failure Class
failurecode.remarks: Indicates Top level of a Failure Hierarchy

hassolution.title: Has Solution
hassolution.remarks: Indicates whether this ticket has a solution or not. This can be either an adhoc one or a referenced solution.

fr1code_longdescription.title: Cause
fr1code_longdescription.remarks: Long description of the cause. If you entered a value in the Solution field, Maximo may enter data here, but you can edit it.

location.title: Location
location.remarks: Identifies the primary location on the incident record. If the incident record is for a location, enter its identifier in the Location field or click the Detail Menu button to select an option and retrieve a value. The Select Value dialog box, by default, displays all locations where the person ID in the Affected Person field is associated with a location record either as location user or as a location custodian. If the Asset Site field contains a value before you use the Select Value dialog box, the list of locations is always filtered by that value. After you select a location, Maximo copies it to the Location field. If the selected location has only a single asset associated with it, Maximo enters its identifier in the Asset field. You can enter related assets and/or locations in the Related Assets table window.

isglobal.title: Global Issue
isglobal.remarks: Specifies whether the ticket is a global one. A global ticket either affects many users or is a root cause of other tickets. If the check box is selected, the ticket is a global. You can view or specify its class in the Global Class field. If the check box is cleared, the ticket is not global.

origfromalert.title: Originates from Alert
origfromalert.remarks: Flag to indicated Monitor generated SRs
